COLLECTION OF TOBACCO CESS RULES, 1968
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 3rd August
1968]
S.R.O 136 (R)/68.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 30, of the Pakistan Tobacco Board
Ordinance, 1968 (I of 1968), the Central Government is pleased to make the
following rules, namely :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These rules may be
called the Collection of Tobacco Cess Rules, 1968.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. Procedure
for collection of cess.‑(l) The cess on tobacco levied under
subsection (i) of section 9 of the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968 (1 of
1968),shall be collected by the Central Excise Department and, after deducting
the cost of collection, be paid to the Pakistan Tobacco Board.
(2) The rules and procedures applicable to the
collection of excise duty on tobacco shall, so far as may be, apply to the
collection under sub‑rule (1) of the cess on tobacco.
